image_description: A close-up, slightly blurry underwater shot of a Rock Beauty fish (Holocanthus tricolor). The fish displays the characteristic black anterior body and head, transitioning to a bright yellow posterior body and tail. It is swimming against a dark, textured background likely representing coral or rock.
